name: text-17
text: Decision before kickoff: does each processed lot use one harvest batch, or combine multiple harvests?

preview: Farming | Harvest batch | Processing | Brand or distributor

text:
This fictional example follows one source harvest batch through processing to its intended brand owner. Farm A, Processor B, Brand C, dates, quantities and identifiers are sample data. Authorized members can read the permitted origin history. The proposed pilot supports one source harvest batch per processed lot. Combined harvests or mixed-farm processing require a revised workflow and scope before commitment. The system records participant-supplied information and does not independently certify authenticity or export eligibility.

Source: proposed Roote Origin MVP scope, MERN revision, 3 October 2026. Final scope and delivery arrangements are subject to client confirmation.

name: text-24
text: Administrator preview, approval and publish/unpublish controls. Each batch has a stable URL and downloadable PNG/SVG QR artwork.

name: text-25
text: Farm ID or QR opens a farm profile. Batch ID or QR opens that batch summary.

The fictional example demonstrates two views of the same batch. Members see records their role and assignment permit. Personal contacts, internal notes and commercial details stay private unless the cooperative explicitly approves publication. Physical printing is outside the proposed MVP. Partners must display the QR for the relevant batch on packaging or at the cafe or restaurant. A farm QR opens a farm profile and does not identify a specific serving or batch. Confirm how partners replace displayed QR artwork when the batch changes.

Source: proposed Roote Origin MVP scope, MERN revision, 3 October 2026. Final scope and delivery arrangements are subject to client confirmation.

preview: Direction | What it emphasizes | What it needs

text:
The three new visual directions share the proposed system features. The client chooses one. From Root to Story emphasizes an immersive vine journey and visible lookup. Grown Together emphasizes growers and a farm catalogue. Purple to the World emphasizes produce and approved batch summaries. Confirm redesign, motion and mobile work before finalizing the schedule. All images are static concepts. No direction assumes export contracts or certification.

Source: proposed Roote Origin MVP scope, MERN revision, 3 October 2026. Final scope and delivery arrangements are subject to client confirmation.

These are proposed delivery and support arrangements, not accepted engagement terms. Confirm revision rounds, training, support duration, handover and ongoing duties for the chosen arrangement. name: text-93
text: Proposed assisted setup: 10 farms, 20 batches and 25 accounts. Ordinary records can be added afterward.

Proposed acceptance includes Android/Chrome and iPhone/Safari camera checks, a backup restore check, operator training and source/documentation handover. Onboarding numbers describe assisted setup, not software record limits. Confirm who maintains the data and which fields may be public. Launch support and its duration depend on the selected working arrangement. Warehouse stock control, external integrations, mixed-origin blending and independent certification remain outside the proposed initial workflow.
